entries.zh: 发怒，动气；亦指激怒、惹怒他人
entries.en: to become angry, to fly into a rage; also to provoke, to enrage
to take offense at trifles; to be roused to anger over small things
entries.notes: H 第二字 [疑:忿/念]，据 M、R 及词头 enojarse de poco 当为「忿」。

entries.en: to get annoyed, to work oneself into a temper
to be angry, to be in a rage
entries.notes: H「荊棘」与词头义不合，M 栏两音节相同，与「荊棘」读音不合，疑为「激激」之讹，释义以 L、M 为据。

entries.en: to be in a towering rage, to be furious
entries.notes: M 栏末混入西语词 mucho（原稿羼入），R 末字与「天」对音不合，释义据 H「氣充天」与词头。

entries.zh: 情急拼命地发怒，气急败坏
entries.en: to rage in desperation; to be beside oneself with anger

entries.zh: 刺心之怒，痛彻心扉地恼怒
entries.en: to cut one to the heart; to be stung into anger
entries.notes: L 栏「imperior muy de rico」文义残乱，释义据 H「切入心」与 R。

entries.en: to weep with rage; to cry bitterly from anger

entries.zh: 触怒尊长（因不服从惹上位者动怒）
entries.en: to provoke a superior's anger (by disobedience)
to have a perverse, short temper; to be ill-tempered
entries.notes: M 栏有改笔与异读（并存两读），R 第二音节 T99 污损，对音不全，释义据 H「氣僻」与词头。

entries.en: to flare up, to show one's wrath suddenly
entries.notes: M 栏音节重复蹿入不可读，R 与 H「發威」相合。

entries.zh: 火性大发，暴怒（如火焰腾起）
entries.en: to blaze up with anger, to flare up like fire

entries.zh: 怒不可遏，气到要杀人（气尽死）
entries.en: to be so furious as to want to kill
entries.notes: M 栏 T99 污损、H 首字 [疑:愾/氣]，释义据「氣盡死」拟测，与词头「欲杀人」相合。

entries.zh: 妒恨，嫉恨成怒〔词头文字残乱，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to burn with jealous hatred
entries.notes: L 栏「lleganalosmenos y depegar」残乱难读、H 首字 [疑:姬/妒]，仅能据「妒恨」定夺。

entries.zh: 侵吞，吞没（他人财物）〔H 与词头不合，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to swallow up, to misappropriate
entries.notes: M 栏 T99 污损，H「吞占」与西语 enojarse & da pena 不合，疑原稿串行。

entries.zh: 威严震怒，盛怒而有威势
entries.en: to be sternly angry, to rage with severity
to be sullenly angry; to show displeasure in one's face
entries.notes: H 作「溫」，据 R vūn 与词头「mal semblante」当为「慍」，形近混写。

entries.en: to be quick-tempered and wilful; to give way to one's temper
entries.notes: L 末词 bertia 残讹（疑 mala bestia／mala condición 之误），H「使性」义明。

entries.zh: 装订（书册）〔原件残缺，释义存疑：R 栏空缺，H「柄」与词头不合〕
entries.en: to bind (books) [R column blank and the given character does not fit; the exact equivalent is uncertain]
entries.notes: R 栏 [空]，H「柄」与 enquadernar 义不合，M 仅单音节，无法定夺对应词。

entries.en: to bind books
entries.notes: H 首字 [疑:裝/栓]，据 M 与词头当为「裝」。

entries.en: to stitch and bind books
entries.notes: H 首字 [疑:釘/鐙]，据 M、R 与词头当为「釘」。
